verdict.rationale: Jev is served only through a hosted endpoint (POST /v1/systemone, model selection by ID), and TypeSafe's own weights are not published. The open-weight 'Open-Jev' models on Hugging Face are third-party reproductions, not TypeSafe releases, so the download-and-run path is not delivered. The 'honest that weights are closed' branch is only implicitly met: the vendor documents hosted-only serving and says 'the same weights serve every account', but never explicitly states that weights are closed or unavailable. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that weights are closed or a weights license, any downloadable first-party weights, and independent confirmation of the vendor's stance.
